mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_log ( mistake_note_id, user_id, review_mode, card_variant, card_prompt_json, user_recall_text, user_note_transient, grade, grade_source, ai_judgment_json, practice_code_review_id, recall_message_id, interval_before, interval_after, ease_factor_before, ease_factor_after, reviewed_at ) VALUES ( #{mistakeNoteId}, #{userId}, #{reviewMode}, #{cardVariant}, #{cardPromptJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{userRecallText}, #{userNoteTransient}, #{grade}, #{gradeSource}, #{aiJudgmentJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{practiceCodeReviewId}, #{recallMessageId}, #{intervalBefore}, #{intervalAfter}, #{easeFactorBefore}, #{easeFactorAfter}, #{reviewedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT rl.id, rl.grade, rl.user_recall_text, rl.user_note_transient, rl.reviewed_at, rl.interval_after FROM review_log rl JOIN mistake_note mn ON mn.id = rl.mistake_note_id WHERE rl.user_id = #{userId} AND rl.mistake_note_id = #{noteId} AND rl.review_mode = 'RECALL' AND mn.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rl.reviewed_at DESC, rl.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
